perspective:
Jose Castillo’s available information includes:

- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual and recalled she was usually vibrant, which made him suspect something might be troubling her.
- He asked if she was okay; she said it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk; she said she appreciated it and it meant a lot.
- He overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He told her that managing finances can be stressful and offered to discuss financial planning strategies; she said that could be helpful and mentioned she’d been overwhelmed with bills.
- He offered to look over budgeting tips together when she felt up to it; she said she would take him up on it soon.
- He worried afterward that he might have overstepped by bringing up finances, so he clarified he only wanted to help, not pry; Patricia said she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for the offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend; she said she appreciated that and was glad to have someone to turn to.
- He later asked how she was doing and about weekend plans; she said she was good and planned a quiet weekend at home, and asked about his plans.
- He said he’d probably catch up on reading and relax, and reminded her she could reach out if she needed anything or wanted to chat; she thanked him and said she’d keep that in mind.
- He continued checking in with her at work; she said she was busy but handling it, thanked him, and said it was great to have his support.
- He offered to help with anything, even just grabbing a coffee, and said they were all there to help each other.
